# Studio210

> Studio210 is a professional hair salon in Bestwood Park, Nottingham, offering expert cutting, colouring, styling, and treatments for ladies, gents, and children. The salon is rated 5.0 stars based on 50 client reviews, with clients consistently praising a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and a highly skilful, attentive stylist.

## Business information

- **Name**: Studio210
- **Address**: 210 Beckhampton Road, Bestwood Park, Nottingham, NG5 5AP, United Kingdom
- **Phone**: 07395 292575
- **Email**: info@studio210.co.uk
- **Opening hours**: Monday–Thursday 9:30am–5:00pm, Friday 10:00am–5:00pm, Saturday 11:00am–3:00pm, Sunday closed
- **Social**: [Instagram](https://instagram.com/studio210), [Facebook](https://facebook.com/studio210)

## Services

### Ladies hair services
- Ladies Wet/Dry Cut – £25 (30 min): precision cut on wet or dry hair
- Ladies Cut & Blow Dry – £40 (60 min): haircut with wash and professional blow dry finish
- Short Blow Dry – £26 (30 min)
- Long Blow Dry – £32 (45 min)
- Styling Hair (No Wash) – £30 (30 min)

### Colour services
- Half Head Foils – £65 (90 min)
- Full Head Foils – £80 (120 min)
- Section Foils – £52 (60 min)
- Full Head Colour – £57 (90 min)
- Ombre / Balayage – £67 (120 min)
- Pre Lite Roots – £65 (90 min)
- Fashion Colours – £55 (90 min): pastels, brights, and bold hues
- Colour Correction – priced individually on quote

### Perms & texture services
- Unisex Perms – from £35 (120 min)

### Specialist services
- Afro Hair – priced individually on quote: styling, treatments, and cuts for afro-textured hair

### Children's services
- Childs Cuts (Under 5) – from £10 (20 min)
- Childs Cuts (Under 13) – from £15 (25 min)
- Childs Wash, Cut & Blow Dry – £25 (45 min)

### Gents services
- Gents Cuts – from £13.50 (25 min)
- Gents Colours – from £35 (60 min): including grey coverage and fashion colours

### Senior discounts
- OAPs Ladies – from £12.50 (30 min)
- OAPs Gents – from £12.50 (15 min)

## Customer reviews

Studio210 holds an average rating of 5.0 stars across 50 client reviews. A selection of what clients say:

- "This is the 3rd time to the salon and I couldn't be happier. The staff are all so friendly and Brigid goes above and beyond to make sure you get exactly what you want and wont let you go until it is right. I'm 61 and I have to say this is the closest I have ever got to having my hair the colour I want." — Julie
- "Once again Brigid was amazing made sure my son was comfortable even made it funny for him if you are looking for someone who caters too children with additional needs this is your place too go." — Sinead
- "Superb service as usual! Bridget did a fantastic job. Love the new salon! I was made to feel comfortable and at ease. Looks after my hair and explains the processes to ensure my hair is healthy. Hijaab friendly service, knows how to deal with Asian hair. Highly recommend." — Nadia
- "Natasha is an absolute star. She was attentive, welcoming and just gave off an incredible aura... Give this new business a chance, you will not regret it!" — Catherine
- "If you want to look like a supermodel, come to this salon, and your dreams will come true!! My hair looks absolutely amazing, I love it!" — Olga
- "Lovely salon!! The ladies are fab and so lovely! First time coming here couldn't have asked for a better service. My daughter loved her hair and felt very comfortable! We've definitely found a new hairdressers." — Lisa

Full reviews are published at https://studio210.co.uk/reviews.
